notes:
TCC Website 0.14.3: first batch of the full code audit

- Code Snippets coexistence removed: the plugin no longer looks for the old snippets.
- Planning Center check: removals held back when Planning Center lists no events or
  loses more than half the approved upcoming ones at once ("They were taken off: remove
  them" button); an approved event with no dates keeps them for one check; a failed dates
  request skips only that event; one retry on 429 (Retry-After, at most 20 s); hidden
  events not fetched, rooms only for approved ones (fetched on Approve); lock released in
  finally; titles compared as plain text and saved without kses ("&" no longer makes
  false conflicts); items gone for 90 days pruned (choices kept), stale conflicts dropped.
- Updates: Update URI header, and any update offer that is not one of our signed
  releases is dropped.
- An edit made before a plugin update shows "Needs a look".
- Search: lookups remembered within a search, events' text built once, results kept up
  to 6 hours (to the end of the next event), more changes start search afresh, mb_substr.
- Trinity Talk reads books from the primed term cache (no query per piece).
- Blank stand-ins for every listed short code of a switched-off feature.
- docs/rollback.md: no more "install 0.6.0 / 0.7.2" or snippet-beside-feature steps.
- Help, AI prompts and notes updated. Tests: 202 pass in WordPress Playground;
  test build checked on staging.
